text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer.
Today is the final day of our training camp,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I have a favor to ask.
If it wouldn't be too much trouble—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I'd like to try running at night."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Per K.S.Miracle's request,
we cut the daytime training short
and decided to resume our session after
dark.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... Ahaha, ha...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The stars are so beautiful,
and the sound of the waves is even more
soothing than during the day...
Running feels amazing right now!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible how different it feels
between day and night.
...It's so wondrous.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're in the exact same place,
it feels like I've stepped into a whole new
world.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If you weren't here with me,
Trainer,
I might have actually thought I got lost.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is rare to hear K.S.Miracle crack a joke
like that.
I can tell she is genuinely enjoying running
along the nighttime beach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her like this makes me feel something
stir within—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run one more lap.
Would it be alright if I picked up the pace
a bit more this—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take off sprinting before K.S.Miracle
can.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instead of just watching her back from
afar
as she runs off saying,
"I'll be right back"—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're running together with me,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Wait for me!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I caught up! But as expected of you,
Trainer.
Your form is so clean and beautiful—
it's truly inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle adjusts her pace to match my
running.
At this rate,
it won't serve as proper training for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if I tell her not to mind me and run
ahead, she'll probably just say,
"I'm fine."
—In that case...
choice_data_list: Let's race! The loser has to do wh...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Declaring that this is a serious match,
I accelerate with all my might.
—The result...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: A-Are you... okay?
choice_data_list: Th-There was no way I could win...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...And yet,
you really gave it everything you had,
just like you said.
What brought that on so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I had a lot of fun,
though.
I never imagined I'd get to run alongside you,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...I wanted you to rely on me more.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to exhaustion from sprinting,
I blurt out my true feelings without holding
back.
That it's okay to lean on me,
that she's allowed to depend on me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than receiving a "thank you," I want
to share in the joy of the moment
when K.S.Miracle can tell all the people
she treasures, "I reached them."

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
....... Yes.
Please let me accept those feelings.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Though... haha.
Haven't I already been depending on you
more than enough, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Asking to run so late at night...
that's pretty selfish of me, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...That's only because of how kind you are,
Trainer.
You're kind to a fault.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why...
even if you aren't asking for it,
I still want to convey them to you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Not just 'I'm okay' or 'Thank you'...
There's more.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(There are words that I want you, and only you,
to receive.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Please. If I'm allowed to lean on you,
I hope you'll accept them.)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...When we win a GⅠ race,
you'll be standing right beside me.
When that time comes,
please listen to what I have in my heart.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Since this race... was my victory,
after all.
...Will you grant my wish?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze is just as earnest and direct as
the day we first met.
Faced with that,
no one could possibly refuse.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: I swear, I'll make sure you win, M...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I will win. I promise you.
No matter what happens...
I'll bring about a miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(—And one day,
to the person whose kindness brings me to
tears...)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I can't wait for the day I can tell
you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ("Thank you for giving me a future.")

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
("Every moment we've spent running
together—")

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...is a miracle you gave to me.)
